name: Quote generation - with extra project context
description: Customer provides extra context about their project (kitchen cabinets) along with the quote request. AI should use generate_quote, return total and PDF link.

messages.text: I'm building kitchen cabinets, need 15 sheets of white melamine 16mm, name is Test

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a quote total with R prefix
Quote should be generated (quote_total populated or PDF URL in reply)
Quote generation may take up to 30 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
No internal optimizer variable names in reply

notes: Tests that extra conversational context (project description) does not interfere with quote extraction. AI should ignore the context and focus on the product details.
